# Charlotta & Lavendar Lewis

- [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) — Commands — [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) — employer of little handmaiden · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to teaching, dealing with schoolroom incidents involving [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), and [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md). Later in October, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) get lost while walking to tea in [West Grafton](../codex/places.md#east-grafton) and discover [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), the secluded home of Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). Miss Lavendar warmly invites them to stay for a pretend tea party she had set up to cure her loneliness.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) enjoy a tea party with Miss Lavendar and her helper, Charlotta the Fourth. Miss Lavendar demonstrates the garden's famous echoes and explains how her helpers came to share the same name. Before departing, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) inadvertently mentions [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), causing a sudden quiet reaction in Miss Lavendar, who gives the girls lavender as they leave.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks through the woods to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) on a winter evening to stay with Miss Lavendar while Charlotta the Fourth is away. During a cozy evening by the fire, Miss Lavendar confides the story of her past romance and falling-out with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). A month later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) brings Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), to meet Miss Lavendar, and the two quickly bond during a delightful visit.
>
> — v2 · XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

> At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) chat during dinner about [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and general curiosities before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) walk to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). There, they are warmly welcomed by Miss Lavendar and Charlotta the Fourth for afternoon food and conversation. Afterward, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) plays with the echoes while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) head off to pick wild strawberries.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

> While picking berries, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) confides in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) her worries about Miss Lavendar's listlessness and recent change in behavior. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) promises to come spend a week at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) after her vacation starts to help cheer Miss Lavendar up. After tea in the garden, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) talks with Miss Lavendar about her imagined dream-boy, before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) head home.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes her two-year term as the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolteacher, prompting the local village women to gossip about the town's future, her pupils' love for her, and Stephen Irving's sudden arrival in town. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) and his father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), who asks her to relay a message to Miss Lavendar. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivers the message to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where she and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) help a nervous Miss Lavendar prepare for Stephen's arrival.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) prepare Miss Lavendar for Stephen Irving's arrival. Stephen arrives and speaks briefly with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) before meeting with Miss Lavendar in the parlor. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) keep themselves busy in the kitchen until they look outside and see Stephen and Miss Lavendar together on the garden bench, happily reunited.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

> In the weeks leading up to Miss Lavendar's wedding, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stays busy helping with preparations and discussing the upcoming romantic events with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), Charlotta the Fourth, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally discovers [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) together in the garden, learning of their secret romance. The following evening, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her engagement, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect on love, change, and her own dreams for the future.
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) before heading to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to help Miss Lavendar and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) prepare for the wedding. The wedding ceremony takes place in the garden, attended by guests including Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md) and [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). After seeing the newly married couple off at the station, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) return to lock up the house and share a quiet, romantic moment together.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House
